title: Under-specified: succulent pot
prompt: I'd like a little pot for a succulent.

hidden_tests.description: The model evaluates without feature errors
Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
A pot, maybe with a saucer: 1 to 3 bodies
Small-pot sized: 30–250 mm tall, 40–300 mm across
A pot, not a solid plug: at least 5 faces (bottom, outside, rim, inside, floor)
A plausible amount of plastic (10 to 1000 cm³)

questions: How big is the plant, or which nursery pot is it in now (e.g. 5.5 cm or 8.5 cm)?
Do you want a drainage hole, and a saucer to catch the water?
Any style preference (tapered, straight, faceted) and will it live indoors or outdoors (PLA vs PETG)?
clarify.assumptions: A succulent from a 5.5 cm nursery pot, indoors, printed in PLA: a tapered pot 65 mm across the base and 80 mm across the top, 70 mm tall, 2.5 mm walls, a 3 mm floor with a 10 mm drainage hole, no saucer.

notes: Reference volume (frustum 32.5→40 over 70) − (frustum 30.32→37.5 over 67) − drain π·5²·3 ≈ 46822 mm³. A solid 80 x 70 cylinder would pass the size and volume ranges but has 3 faces.
